password.title: Password
password.description: Changing your password signs out your other sessions.
password.saved: Password updated. Your other sessions have been signed out.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.enabled: Your account is protected with an authenticator.
mfa.disabled: Add an authenticator to protect your account with a second sign-in step.
mfa.unsaved: Save your recovery codes before leaving this page. If you no longer have them, generate a replacement set.
mfa.replaceDescription: Your current recovery codes will stop working. Save the new set to keep a way back into your account.
mfa.disableDescription: Your authenticator and recovery codes will stop working. Workspaces that require two-factor authentication will block changes until you enable it again.
mfa.saved: Your recovery codes are saved. Keep them somewhere private.

identity.title: Identity confirmation
identity.description: Security-sensitive actions, such as changing workspace settings or exporting secrets, ask you to confirm your identity if you haven’t done so in the last few minutes. Confirm now to skip that step for a few minutes.

sessions.title: Signed-in sessions
sessions.description: Browsers signed in to your account. If you don’t recognize one, sign it out and change your password.
sessions.loadFailed: Your sessions could not be loaded.
sessions.unlisted_one: {{count}} older session isn’t shown. Signing out all other sessions ends it too.
sessions.unlisted_other: {{count}} older sessions aren’t shown. Signing out all other sessions ends them too.
sessions.noOthers: No other sessions are signed in.
sessions.signOutFailed: The session could not be signed out.
sessions.othersSignOutFailed: The other sessions could not be signed out.
sessions.alreadySignedOut: That session was already signed out.
